messages:
Olivia: Hi team, quick onboarding/benefits question. I enrolled in medical but didn’t see any mention of dependent coverage confirmation. How do I know my spouse is added?
Olivia: Also I submitted direct deposit but it still shows pending in Workday. First payday is Friday.
people-ops-bot: Welcome Olivia! Links: benefits portal https://benefits.redwood.example, Workday payroll https://workday.redwood.example (SSO).
Maya (People Ops): Hi Olivia 000Congrats and welcome. For dependents: if you added them in the benefits portal you should receive a confirmation email within 48 hours and a pending document request if we need proof. Check the "Dependents" section in the portal.
Maya (People Ops): If proof is required (marriage cert, birth cert), the portal will show what to upload. You have 30 days to provide docs to keep them on the plan.
Olivia: I did upload a marriage cert the same day. Is there a place to check if it processed?
Maya (People Ops): If it was uploaded you should see status "Submitted" then "Verified" after benefits team reviews. If still "Submitted" after 3 business days, tag this thread and I’ll chase it.
Lina (Payroll): On direct deposit: if Workday shows pending it likely missed the payroll cutoff. If you want to be safe, confirm the routing/account numbers are correct and pm me a note. If it missed cutoff we can issue a manual ACH but need approval.
Raj (Recruiting): Olivia FYI I forwarded your relocation approval to Finance last week, so that should be in the queue; let us know if you don’t see it in Expensify.
Olivia: Thanks! One more 000are company holidays pro-rated for mid-month hires? I started on the 10th.
Maya (People Ops): Company observed holidays apply to everyone and are not pro-rated. Floating holidays and PTO accrual follow the handbook and prorate based on hire date; see https://handbook.redwood.example/pto.
Olivia: Perfect. I’ll watch for the benefits verification email and ping if direct deposit still shows pending after Friday. Thanks all :thumbsup:
